title: An injective module sheaf is injective among presheaves of modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $R$ a commutative ring, $R_X$ the constant sheaf of rings on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$, and $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$ the category of sheaves of $R_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]; let $\mathrm{PMod}(R_X)$ be the category of presheaves of $R_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. If $I$ is an injective object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $I$, regarded as a presheaf of $R_X$-modules, is an injective object of $\mathrm{PMod}(R_X)$. (Stacks states this for any ringed site.)
